reason: Conversation 1 hit the sensible first step immediately (thermostat setting and food blocking the vent), correctly treated max dial plus a rammed fridge as the likely cause, gave a reasonable follow-up on the residual yoghurt freezing, and kept the damper/thermostat fault as a conditional escalation with a thermometer check rather than asserting it. Conversation 2 never asked about the thermostat until the customer volunteered it, instead pushed an unsupported defrost-fault theory, asked for a 24-hour unplug and then had the homeowner prying off a cover with a screwdriver hunting for a drain hole she couldn't find, and it misread 'moved stuff forward' as 'moving the food hasn't stopped the freezing' before any time had passed. Its final reply was also confused ('leave it like this' without clearly telling her to turn the dial down) and gave no guidance on when to escalate or on the residual freezing.
